definitions.explanation: A general positive evaluation. Can describe quality, condition, character, or suitability. One of the most frequently used adjectives in Japanese.
Used to give permission or indicate that something is acceptable. いいですよ (That's fine / Go ahead).
Used to politely decline an offer. When someone offers you something, いいです can mean 'No, thank you' or 'I'm fine (without it).'

examples.english: He's a nice person, isn't he?

notes:
いい has irregular conjugation — all inflected forms use the stem ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧- from the alternate form ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧.

FORMS:
- Negative: ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not good)
- Past: ⟦よかった→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (was good)
- Adverbial: ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ (well, often)
- Te-form: ⟦よくて→良い：02350_yoi⟧

The form いい is used only in the plain present affirmative. ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ is more formal or literary.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧いい: may I...? / it's okay to... (permission)
- 〜⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧いい: don't have to... (no obligation)
- 〜⟦ば→ば：noentry⟧/たらいい: should, it would be good to...
- 〜た⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いい: had better..., you should... (advice about a specific action)

REGISTER:
In formal speech and service situations, ⟦よろしい→よろしい：01176_yoroshii⟧ replaces いい: ⟦よろしい→よろしい：01176_yoroshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Is that all right?).

AMBIGUITY NOTE:
いい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ can mean either "that's good/fine" (acceptance) or "no thank you" (refusal), depending on context and intonation. When declining, it is often accompanied by ⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ or a hand gesture.
